note.en: Consider Thomas for 1D tridiagonal systems, CG for symmetric positive-definite systems, and geometric multigrid for regular-grid Poisson problems. A small SPD-diffusion SA-AMG supplement builds a matrix-based hierarchy, separately from geometric multigrid.
